usageNotes: Acquires a cluster-wide exclusive lock before making SDN configuration changes; any subsequent apply or edit operation requires this lock to succeed first. The caller must hold the SDN.Allocate privilege on /sdn. By default the lock will be denied if there are already pending (unapplied) SDN changes — pass allow-pending: true only when you intentionally want to layer additional changes on top of an existing pending diff.

examples.summary: Acquire SDN lock before editing zone/VNET configuration

tips: The returned string is a lock token or confirmation value — retain it for debugging; the lock is cluster-scoped so concurrent SDN edits from other sessions will block until it is released.
Always pair this call with the corresponding unlock or apply operation to avoid leaving the SDN config locked and blocking other administrators.
Use allow-pending: true with caution in automation — it means you may apply a config that includes changes from a prior, unreviewed session.
